Class RcxLcd

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx.RcxLcd
public final class RcxLcd extends Object
An RCX brick's display, from RemoteRcx.getLcd(). Its commands need Juno's own RCX firmware (RcxRemoteFirmware); LEGO's firmware does not know them and does not answer.

  • Method Details

    • showNumber

      public boolean showNumber(int value)
      Shows value, limited to MIN_NUMBER..MAX_NUMBER, in place of JUno until the next call. Returns whether the brick acknowledged.

    • showIcon

      public boolean showIcon(int icon, boolean lit)
      Lights the icon icon, ICON_*, or with lit false hands it back to the brick, which lights some icons from its own state: running motors' arrows, pressed touch sensors, low battery, and the minifigure. Returns whether the brick acknowledged.

    • clear

      public boolean clear()
      Blanks the display, its number and icons too (but for the IR cones that show the brick receiving), until showNumber(int) or showText(String). Returns whether the brick acknowledged.

    • showText

      public boolean showText(String text)
      Shows the first four characters of text in place of a number, with no icons but the IR cones, until showNumber(int). A seven-segment display approximates some letters ("VIEW" shows as UIEu) and shows characters it cannot draw blank. Sends one command per digit; returns whether the brick acknowledged them all.
